title: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression with Context Reconstruction
one_line_claim: Query-agnostic KV cache compression using attention-based importance scoring and forward-pass context reconstruction achieves 4-8x compression with minimal accuracy loss.
method_summary: KVzip scores KV pairs by maximum attention activation across chunks (O(mn_m) via chunking rather than O(n^2)), then reconstructs missing KV entries during inference by running forward passes to recompute activations. Partitions context into chunks, computes layer-wise attention importance scores per KV head, prunes lowest-scoring pairs, and reconstructs via recomputation as needed.

key_findings.finding: KVzip achieves 4-8x compression ratios while maintaining task accuracy across SQuAD, GSM8K, NIAH, and other benchmarks, with <1% average accuracy degradation.
key_findings.quote: Our method achieves 4-8x compression with minimal accuracy loss... we evaluate on multiple benchmarks including SQuAD 2.0, GSM8K, and long-context understanding tasks

key_findings.finding: Chunked scoring reduces computational complexity from O(n^2) to O(mn_m).
key_findings.quote: Our chunked scoring approach partitions the context into chunks of size m and computes scores within each chunk, reducing complexity from O(n^2) to O(mn_m)

key_findings.finding: Forward-pass reconstruction of pruned KV entries incurs 5-15% latency overhead per reconstructed token.
key_findings.quote: Reconstruction latency adds approximately 5-15% overhead per reconstructed token, making selective reconstruction feasible during generation

relation_to_herald.shared: Both address KV-cache compression; both evaluate on compression-sensitive tasks (GSM8K, long-context reasoning) where failures manifest.
differs_on: KVzip performs query-agnostic pruning at compression time using attention importance scoring; HERALD predicts catastrophic failures during generation via per-token logit features, treating compressor as black box.
KVzip reconstructs missing KV values on-demand via recomputation; HERALD only signals when compression is likely to cause non-termination or looping.
KVzip optimizes for accuracy across diverse tasks; HERALD optimizes for early detection of catastrophic failure modes.
